_rewrites_note: The app asks /api/... for data. On the device the ESP32 answers; on Hosting
nothing does, so the request must 404 — that is the signal the app uses to
reach localApiFallback(), which supabase-bridge.js then answers from Supabase.
A catch-all rewrite would return index.html with status 200 for /api/*,
the app would get HTML instead of JSON, and every screen would stay empty.
The app routes with #hash (/#/home), so deep links never need a rewrite.
